style.backgroundSystem: flat board-formed concrete field #75787D for the opening screen, cool-white #FAFCFD and pale mist #EDF3F7 hard-edged panels for every information screen, one azure band #0F86C5 as the only graphic field, shadowed cabinet interior #1F262C for the installed view
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line circular icon wells left empty, hairline dividers and ticks, blank ring badges and one blank scalloped seal frame, nothing that reads as a certification mark
style.lightingSystem: cool even studio light with a soft key from the upper left at 5500K, gentle falloff, faint short contact shadow only, no warm bounce, no dramatic specular streaks
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium clean-water appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool-white field #FAFCFD, board-formed concrete #75787D, pale mist panel #EDF3F7, one azure accent #0F86C5 and ink text #1F262C; cool even studio lighting with a soft key from the upper left at 5500K, faint short contact shadows and no warm bounce; modern geometric sans-serif only; single-weight thin-line circular icons drawn as empty wells, blank ring badges and one blank scalloped seal; hard-edged flat material panels with one clean horizon seam, never photographic depth blur; stable upright product scale and the same left-facing side; every badge, seal, ring, tab, numeral, spec cell and screen area stays blank as a placeholder; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented figures.
noDrift: no brand wordmarks, LOGO plates, store corner badges or QR codes
no digits, readouts, percentages, stage counts, material names or units drawn on screens, seals, rings, tabs or spec rows
no warm wood, mint or marble-veined surfaces replacing the concrete #75787D and azure #0F86C5 system
no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no gradient washes, no photographic background blur in the information panels
no inconsistent lighting direction and no mismatched icon stroke weights
style.presentationRules: the unit keeps one true upright scale and the same left-facing side across the set, never re-scaled, never clipped by the frame edge, any display or indicator area stays unlit and blank
style.surfaceSystem: matte poured-stone riser #D6DBE0, cool laminate counter #EDF3F7, brushed sink rim, cabinet interior #1F262C
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif, headline 28-40pt, sub-line 16pt, labels 10-14pt, all in-image Chinese left as placeholders
